# Data loading

```{r}
base_path <- "../data/clean/"
normal_1rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_1rps-2min_normal.jtl"))
normal_3rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_3rps-2min_normal.jtl"))
normal_5rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_5rps-2min_normal.jtl"))
normal_7rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_7rps-2min_normal.jtl"))
normal_10rpsX2min <- read.csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_10rps-2min_normal.jtl"))
cache_1rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_1rps-2min_cache.jtl"))
cache_3rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_3rps-2min_cache.jtl"))
cache_5rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_5rps-2min_cache.jtl"))
cache_7rpsX2min <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, "load-test_7rps-2min_cache.jtl"))

normal_1rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(normal_1rpsX2min$responseCode)
normal_3rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(normal_3rpsX2min$responseCode)
normal_5rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(normal_5rpsX2min$responseCode)
normal_7rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(normal_7rpsX2min$responseCode)
normal_10rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(normal_10rpsX2min$responseCode)
cache_1rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(cache_1rpsX2min$responseCode)
cache_3rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(cache_3rpsX2min$responseCode)
cache_5rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(cache_5rpsX2min$responseCode)
cache_7rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(cache_7rpsX2min$responseCode)
cache_10rpsX2min$responseCode <- as.character(cache_10rpsX2min$responseCode)
```

# Normalize the timestamp

```{r}
normalize <- function(timestamp_col) {
  minimum <- min(timestamp_col)
  maximum <- max(timestamp_col)
  timestamp_norm <- (timestamp_col - minimum) / (maximum - minimum)
  return(timestamp_norm)
}
```

Execute in each dataset.
```{r}
normal_1rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(normal_1rpsX2min$timeStamp)
normal_3rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(normal_3rpsX2min$timeStamp)
normal_5rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(normal_5rpsX2min$timeStamp)
normal_7rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(normal_7rpsX2min$timeStamp)
normal_10rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(normal_10rpsX2min$timeStamp)
cache_1rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(cache_1rpsX2min$timeStamp)
cache_3rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(cache_3rpsX2min$timeStamp)
cache_5rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(cache_5rpsX2min$timeStamp)
cache_7rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(cache_7rpsX2min$timeStamp)
cache_10rpsX2min$timeStamp <- normalize(cache_10rpsX2min$timeStamp)
```

# Joining data sources

```{r}
normal_1rpsX2min$mode <- "normal"
normal_3rpsX2min$mode <- "normal"
normal_5rpsX2min$mode <- "normal"
normal_7rpsX2min$mode <- "normal"
normal_10rpsX2min$mode <- "normal"
cache_1rpsX2min$mode <- "cache"
cache_3rpsX2min$mode <- "cache"
cache_5rpsX2min$mode <- "cache"
cache_7rpsX2min$mode <- "cache"
cache_10rpsX2min$mode <- "cache"

load_1rpsX2min <- bind_rows(normal_1rpsX2min, cache_1rpsX2min)
load_3rpsX2min <- bind_rows(normal_3rpsX2min, cache_3rpsX2min)
load_5rpsX2min <- bind_rows(normal_5rpsX2min, cache_5rpsX2min)
load_7rpsX2min <- bind_rows(normal_7rpsX2min, cache_7rpsX2min)
load_10rpsX2min <- bind_rows(normal_10rpsX2min, cache_10rpsX2min)
```

# Viewing data

Define a common bar plot.
```{r}
bar_plotter <- function(test_data, rps) {
  ggplot(test_data) + 
    geom_bar(aes(x = responseCode), fill = c("dodgerblue")) + 
    facet_grid(.~mode) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Códigos de respuesta para ", rps, "rps/2min"), 
      x = "Número de respuesta", 
      y = "Frecuencia absoluta"
    )
}
```

Use in datasets.
```{r}
bar_plotter(load_1rpsX2min, 1)
bar_plotter(load_3rpsX2min, 3)
bar_plotter(load_5rpsX2min, 5)
bar_plotter(load_7rpsX2min, 7)
bar_plotter(load_10rpsX2min, 10)
```

Filter the data for only use response codes 200.
```{r}
load_10rpsX2min <- subset(load_10rpsX2min, responseCode == "200")
```

Define a common box plot.
```{r}
box_plotter <- function(test_data, rps) {
  ggplot(test_data) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(x = mode, y = Latency)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Representación de caja por cada fuente [", rps, "rps/2min]"), 
      x = "Fuente", 
      y = "Latencia [ms]"
    )
}
```

Use in datasets.
```{r}
box_plotter(load_1rpsX2min, 1)
box_plotter(load_3rpsX2min, 3)
box_plotter(load_5rpsX2min, 5)
box_plotter(load_7rpsX2min, 7)
box_plotter(load_10rpsX2min, 10)
```

Define a common scatter plot.
```{r}
scatter_plotter <- function(test_data, rps) {
  ggplot(test_data) + 
    geom_point(aes(x = Latency, y = elapsed, color = mode)) + 
    facet_wrap(~mode) + 
    labs(
      title = paste0("Dispersión de latencia contra tiempo total [", rps, "rps/2min]"), 
      x = "Latencia [ms]", 
      y = "Tiempo total [ms]"
    ) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("indianred1", "lightskyblue"))
}
```

Use in datasets.
```{r}
scatter_plotter(load_1rpsX2min, 1)
scatter_plotter(load_3rpsX2min, 3)
scatter_plotter(load_5rpsX2min, 5)
scatter_plotter(load_7rpsX2min, 7)
scatter_plotter(load_10rpsX2min, 10)
```

Define a common density plot.
```{r}
density_plotter <- function(test_data, rps) {
  ggplot(test_data) + 
    geom_density(aes(x = Latency, color = mode, fill = mode), alpha = 0.9) + 
    labs(
      title = paste0("Curvas de densidad por cada fuente [", rps, "rps/2min]"), 
      x = "Latencia [ms]", 
      y = "Densidad"
    ) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("indianred1", "lightskyblue")) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("indianred1", "lightskyblue"))
}
```

Use in datasets.
```{r}
density_plotter(load_1rpsX2min, 1)
density_plotter(load_3rpsX2min, 3)
density_plotter(load_5rpsX2min, 5)
density_plotter(load_7rpsX2min, 7)
density_plotter(load_10rpsX2min, 10)
```

Define a common time series plot.
```{r}
time_plotter <- function(test_data, rps) {
  ggplot(test_data) + 
    geom_line(aes(x = timeStamp, y = Latency, color = mode)) + 
    facet_wrap(~mode, nrow = 2, ncol = 1, scales = "free") + 
    labs(
      title = paste0("Serie de tiempo para la latencia [", rps, "rps/2min]"), 
      x = "Linea de tiempo normalizada", 
      y = "Latencia [ms]"
    ) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("indianred1", "lightskyblue"))
}
```

Use in datasets.
```{r}
time_plotter(load_1rpsX2min, 1)
time_plotter(load_3rpsX2min, 3)
time_plotter(load_5rpsX2min, 5)
time_plotter(load_7rpsX2min, 7)
time_plotter(load_10rpsX2min, 10)
```
